answer: Ocean-scope escrow gating: every identity posts a 0.20-unit escrow before acting; a verifiable randomness signal at epoch E+3 decides which escrows must reveal. Flow: (1) an agent locks a hidden commit hash for 3 epochs; (2) the beacon publishes its salt at E+3; (3) a 16-member mirror committee re-attests that value per shard; (4) false reveals forfeit escrow to an audit fund. Cost: 100 sybils lock 20.0 units; the beacon is unpredictable at commit, so coordinated votes match the draw at 1/64, expected recovery 20/64 = 0.31 units versus 20 locked.
